summary: Full validation of the v6 DynoPay homepage redesign — backend metrics endpoint, header at all desktop widths (English & Spanish), mega-menus, command menu, 6-language switcher, mobile drawer at 390px, SSR of live metrics, all 10 section IDs, LandingNav chip bar, PricingTeaser calculator, FAQ (8 items + JSON-LD + help-support link), footer, theme toggle, console hygiene, and public route regression. Everything passes acceptance criteria. Zero console errors, zero duplicate-key React warnings, zero hydration errors. Only pre-existing next/head <script> warnings remain (acceptable per request).

critical_code_review_comments: Header desktop layout at 1101/1200/1300/1366/1440/1920 all pass no-overlap and start-inside-viewport in EN and ES — CSS-only fix works.
Countries figure is rendered as '55+' in SSR (rounded-down + suffix) while API returns 56. Intentional presentation; not a placeholder. If exact number desired, format server-side before render.
Cold-compile 502 on /auth/register (first hit) is a Next.js dev-server characteristic, not an app bug.
Two elements share data-testid="theme-toggle-button" (header + likely mobile drawer). Consider suffixing (e.g. -header / -mobile) to avoid ambiguity in tests.
test_credentials: Not required — homepage/public pages only. Merchant creds available in /app/memory/test_credentials.md if needed (READ-ONLY, prod SAFE MODE).
